question: Which sport is associated with Rafael Nadal, recipient of the 2025 Sporting Icon Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tennis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rafael Nadal** is a world-renowned professional athlete from **Spain** who has dominated the sport of **Tennis** for over two decades.
 
• He is the recipient of the **2025 Sporting Icon Award**, a prestigious honor bestowed upon him in recognition of his unparalleled contribution to the sport, his resilient spirit, and his role as a global ambassador for athletic excellence.
 
• Known affectionately as the **"King of Clay,"** Nadal is most famous for his record-breaking performance at **Roland Garros (The French Open)**, where he has won a staggering **14 titles**, a feat unmatched by any other player in the history of the game.
 
• Throughout his illustrious career, he has captured a total of **22 Grand Slam men's singles titles**, placing him among the top three most successful male players of all time alongside **Novak Djokovic** and **Roger Federer**.
